quote: The truth is, your life will always reflect the level of standards you said. Stop acting like the bare minimum is enough. Keep tolerating weak effort, toxic people, sloppy habits, and that's exactly what you're keeping in. Demand more from the way you work, the way you treat you, the way you spend your time. Because the moment you raise your standards, your life quietly begins to change.
